shadow:
Something in a life comes loose. The footing that held for years stops holding, and for a while there is no name for what is happening, only a swirl with no edges. The mind hates this. It cannot stand a state it cannot label, so it scrambles, builds reasons, picks at the fog for a thread to pull.

That scramble is confusion. It is not the fog itself. The fog is just raw material with no shape yet, the way things looked before any world had formed. Confusion is what the mind does to it, the gripping, the racing for an answer that is not ready. The answer it grabs is always too early, and action taken from inside the swirl only thickens the swirl.

Most people read this stretch as a problem and rush to fix it. That is the misread. The fog is not a failure of clarity, it is the room a real change needs before it can land. What it asks for is plain and almost dull: time. Not more thinking. Time. The thing wants to settle on its own, the way water clears when you stop stirring it. You wait, and you do not act yet, which feels like nothing.
repressive: Some meet the fog by copying. They reach for what a parent did, what the people around them do, and wear that borrowed shape as if it were a settled life. It passes for stability. Underneath, the change never got to happen.
reactive: Others cannot hold the pressure of it. The unease leaks outward as blame and sudden heat, lashing at whatever is near. It looks like they are fighting their way clear. They are only spreading the swirl onto everyone in reach.
gift:
When the fog is finally given its time, something moves in it. The swirl that felt like nothing turns out to be loaded, full of pictures waiting for a shape, and the mind stops fighting it and starts painting with it instead.

That is imagination. The word shares a root with magic, and the link is honest. Imagination here is not daydreaming or a clever line of work. It is the nerve to take a thing that did not exist, a tower, a teaching, a new way of living, and pull it out of the mist into matter. The fog was never empty. It was the stock the new thing gets made from.

This Gift carries an edge most people skip past. It is not enough to see the vision. It has to be built, risked, and that asks for courage, because building it overturns the safe little arrangement you had. It asks for patience too. Push the creative current and it shuts off. Pictures arrive on their own clock.

And it never calls a thing finished. Every shape is provisional, before completion. There is always a further leap it can make, and that openness is the only door a real surprise comes through.
siddhi:
Far enough on, the fog is not something a person passes through. It is the holiest ground there is, and they know it without needing to think it. The mind has gone quiet, and in that quiet the confusion simply ends, which shows how thin it always was.

What floods in is light. Not the light the eyes catch, an inner light that was folded into the cells the whole time, waiting for evolution to let it show. From here a life becomes an easel for the imagining of the universe itself. Words come, images come, and they are not authored so much as passed along, lit from a source the person no longer stands between.

Such a one lights a room by being in it. The eyes carry it. People feel it and feel their own light answer. And looking back down the whole road, the fog at the start, the swirl that felt like losing the thread, was never a wrong turn. It was the raw matter. It was the dark the light was always sleeping inside.
